title: SamLi Thrift Website and Store
description: An online thrift store for a Nigerian fashion vendor. Shoppers can search and filter by category, style and environment, browse graded products with clear prices in ₦, and order through WhatsApp. Built with React and SCSS as a fast, mobile-friendly storefront that earns buyers' trust.

title: Aluminum Calc (Upgrade)
description: A React rebuild of my Aluminum Calc, the toolkit of calculators for aluminum and glass fabricators, including item pricing. Rebuilt as a cleaner, more scalable base so new calculators are easier to add. Still in active development.

title: Aluminum Calc
